method.baseline: Current compareSections weights first 3/4 bars strongly in four-bar sections or first 6/8 bars in eight-bar sections, with final tail weight 0.25. It accepts score >=0.82 AND rootScore >=0.78. Canonical brick names are supporting evidence, not the sole equality test.
method.prefix: Compare exact chord-root pitch classes, declared compound interval sets, explicit slash bass and timed spans over a common head, at original absolute pitch (shift0). Chord spelling aliases with equal vocabulary intervals are equivalent. Break at first mismatch. No clipped chord is a match.
method.decision: Source-audited narrow overrides for16,94,241: identical same-pitch/rhythm chord head spanning at least half of the complete A length, plus source passage/brick context supporting a varied ending. Keep97,112,191 separate because second sections lack a half-length common head and show different whole-section trajectories.
method.thresholdWarning: Do not lower global full-section thresholds to0.71 or accept any shared start. Only11/96 original AABAs had stable ending bricks, and section identity can survive a modified tail, but permissive matching must not erase distinct middle sections. The six-row audit supports explicit decisions, not a universal inferred-form rule.
method.layout: For accepted A variations, preserve base identity A for vertical alignment, optionally carry a separate displayLabel A-prime. Relabel the old third-section C to B. Keep musical event timing, source brick identities and modulation data unchanged.

recommendation.aabaSubgroupCounts: Refresh the subgroup audit for corrected99 membership after these decisions. Prior96-standard statistics were conditional on the previous membership. Current aaba-subgroups.json is refreshed to99; source hashes identify the corrected metadata.
